target_customer: Robotics builders and physical AI labs that need robot policies and simulation evaluation
problem: Robot policies usually need per-task fine-tuning and teleoperation data. Runtime.si builds policies that explore in simulation and act in the real world without them, and evaluation infrastructure for physical AI.
business_model: Robot policy and simulation evaluation platform, early access, pricing not published
product_category: Simulation based robot policies and evaluation

founders.name: Chen Peng
founders.background_notes: YC page: model interpretability and brain foundation model work at Penn.

founders.name: Yim Ying
founders.background_notes: YC page: full-stack robotics engineer, manipulation and manufacturing.

founders.name: Liam Zhong
founders.background_notes: YC page: computer vision, control and RL researcher with CVPR, ECCV and NeurIPS review and authorship.

competitors.name: Genesis AI
competitors.what: Full-stack robotics models with an open-source simulation platform, Genesis World 1.0 released May 2026

competitors.name: NVIDIA Cosmos
competitors.what: World foundation models and simulation for physical AI
competitors.traction_then: Described as the de facto open infrastructure layer

technical_complexity.rationale: Policies that act in the real world after simulation search without fine-tuning or teleoperation are research-grade. The site lists open benchmarks SimInfinity and Nomad-Harness and verbal reinforcement learning research.

defensibility.rationale: Result quality is unproven and rivals have far more capital. Open-source benchmarks help adoption but do not block copying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded players were shipping simulation platforms and world models before the batch; no later outcome yet.

market_need_then: Press in 2026 reports billions flowing into world model and physical AI startups, with simulation seen as a way to cut data collection cost.

branding.name_origin: The site defines it: the moment a program stops being a plan and starts to act
branding.domain_note: runtime.si, a .si country-code domain; how it was acquired is not stated

identity.voice_and_tone: Minimal, confident, technical, short declarative lines

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Robotics intelligence can scale with simulation and search.

brand_strength.rationale: The site gives the name a definition but the word Runtime is generic and shared with many products. No brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Runtime.si joined YC in Fall 2026 with three Penn robotics researchers and has no public outcome. It is backed by Pareto, YC and the NVIDIA Inception Program per its site, and early access opens in January. It faces very well funded simulation and robotics model players, so results on its benchmarks will decide traction.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists 125k seed, locked; the site names Pareto, YC and NVIDIA Inception as backers without amounts, so no round recorded and coverage is partial. No outcome news found. Some YC job pages carry boilerplate for Lambda Robotics, relationship unconfirmed. Update: the 125K seed is recorded with no date from a single database (Dealroom, paywalled); a cross-check search found no press and did not confirm Pareto or NVIDIA Inception.
